# Own the Block v1.11.1

## Power-up inventory and activation — OB-6

- Balanced inventory gallery for zero, one, two or three cards, with a clear empty state and separate status/opponent sections.
- Consistent collectible-card depth across inventory, details, replacement and activation. Artwork and text remain 2D; owned-card motion is restrained and respects reduced motion.
- Action icons alongside text; player targeting uses the same dropdown design as language selection, with viewport-safe positioning and keyboard navigation.
- Activation uses Cancel rather than Discard new card; cancellation preserves the card and allowance, including while disconnected. Reward claim/decline/replacement retain their meaning.
- Remove the last outcome line under the inventory button while retaining authoritative history.

## Compatibility and distribution

Application 1.11.1; socket protocol 16; RAM snapshot 14; minimum supported version 1.11.0. Compatible with protocol-16 v1.11.0 clients. No gameplay rules, card effects, rarity, protocol, migration or hosting architecture change. Windows Squirrel update feed and macOS DMG distribution remain unchanged. Finish a hosted match before restarting to update; host state lives only in RAM.

## Verification

The Owner reports OB-6 testing OK and explicitly authorizes production (OWNER-REPORTED). Local full-suite/type/lint/build/docs, browser and packaged Windows Electron checks, five viewports and artwork parity passed for OB-6. Publication requires release quality gates, all three distribution targets and packaged integrity proofs.

Installers remain unsigned; macOS is not notarized under the existing tag workflow. Physical GPU performance, real macOS device use, cross-device/network testing and a full-system Power-up balance review are not established by the OB-6 sign-off. See project-document/releases/V1_11_1_RELEASE_VERIFICATION.md.
